protocol.gc: Two HeapProfiler.collectGarbage calls with task boundaries after pending persistence/two animation frames; prune cleared weak probes; one cleanup GC before heap/counter capture
protocol.controls: Strongly held object/node survive; released object/node weak references clear
protocol.operations: Allocation input; locale switch with exact numerical parity; local feedback open/input/close; canonical English/20 allocation endpoint
protocol.network: Only local snapshot GET/HEAD; local feedback configuration disabled; no submission
protocol.retentionRule: A retired sampled object surviving at least two further complete rounds and their full GC checkpoints requires investigation; this is not proof of an unbounded leak
protocol.interpretation: Heap, document, node and listener trends require independent review; no percentage or slope threshold establishes a leak or leak-free status

summary.interpretation: Review raw trends; no automatic leak/plateau conclusion from heap deltas or slopes

limitations: Bounded eight rounds per context, not hours of use
Weak probes cover selected retired calculator objects, not every allocation
No physical mobile device or native screen reader
Local snapshots without external sprites, production feedback API or Turnstile
